class.name: GodotDoctorResourceHelper
class.brief_description: A utility class providing helpers for resolving resource paths. Converts [code]uid://[/code] paths to [code]res://[/code] paths when needed.

method.name: to_res_path
method.description: Converts [param path] from a uid:// path to a res:// path if needed, otherwise returns it as-is if it's already a res:// path. If the path is not valid, logs an error and exits with failure if in headless mode.
